newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index steady Oct 20 wk.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index steady Oct 20 wk.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News consumer comfort index held steady at -5 in the week ended October 20.

The survey, this time with 1,031 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
Respondents' confidence in the economy rose two points to match was unchanged at -14.
Confidence in personal finances slipped to 20 from 22, and Americans' rating of buying climate held steady at -22.
Regionally, confidence increased in the South and Midwest, but it declined in the West and Northeast.
